New gotcha for future Agent Hub cases: the Catalog's category filter-rail chip selected state (e.g. 'My Liked') is client-only UI state and does NOT survive a full page reload/re-navigation — any test that reloads mid-flow while relying on a category filter must re-click the chip afterward or it will silently read the unfiltered default view.
